question: What was the theme of the 9th Siddha Day celebrations held in Chennai in January 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Siddha for Global Health.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The 9th Siddha Day was celebrated in Chennai on January 3, 2026, ahead of National Siddha Day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The theme of the 9th Siddha Day was “Siddha for Global Health”.**
 
• The theme highlighted Siddha medicine’s role in preventive healthcare.
 
• It emphasised research, innovation and global wellness challenges.
 
• The celebrations aimed to integrate Siddha into mainstream healthcare systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Siddha Day__

 __
 
• National Siddha Day is observed annually on January 6.
 
• It honours Sage Agathiyar, regarded as the father of Siddha medicine.
 
• Siddha is one of the oldest traditional medical systems of India.
 
 
 
• Organising Institutions__
 __
 
• Ministry of Ayush.
 
• National Institute of Siddha (NIS).
 
• Central Council for Research in Siddha (CCRS).
 
• Tamil Nadu Directorate of Indian Medicine and Homoeopathy.
 
 
 
• Event Highlights__
 
 
• Inaugurated by Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan.
 
• Participation from Siddha practitioners, scientists and students.
 
• Five eminent contributors to Siddha medicine were felicitated.
